primitives.name: Blood-Brain Barrier Disruption to S100B Correlation
primitives.verbatim_quote: After a game, transient BBB damage measured by serum S100B was detected only in players experiencing the greatest number of sub-concussive head hits.
primitives.assumptions: Linear dependence of S100B surge on head hit frequency; BBBD is quantifiable via serum S100B threshold.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When S100B exceeds 0.12 ng/mL, indicative of BBB disruption.

layer2.mapping: S100B serum concentration serves as proxy for BBB integrity in GSI Bayesian models.

primitives.name: Autoantibody Response to S100B
primitives.verbatim_quote: Elevated levels of autoantibodies against S100B were elevated only after repeated sub-concussive events characterized by BBBD.
primitives.assumptions: Autoantibody production is triggered exclusively by BBBD; temporal lag between BBBD and antibody rise.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Only after repeated BBBD episodes does autoantibody level exceed baseline.
